en: Morning! The sun comes up. Hello, sun!
The sun is high and hot. Adik plays in the shade. Hat on!
The sun goes down, down, down. The sky turns orange.
Now it is dark. Goodnight, sun! See you in the morning.
id: Matahari tinggi dan panas. Adik bermain di tempat teduh. Pakai topi!
Matahari turun, turun, turun. Langit menjadi jingga.
Sekarang sudah gelap. Selamat malam, matahari! Sampai jumpa besok pagi.

readAloudNotes.en: Stretch your arms up slowly like the rising sun.
readAloudNotes.id: Rentangkan tangan pelan-pelan ke atas seperti matahari terbit.

readAloudNotes.en: Pat your child's head as if putting on a hat.
readAloudNotes.id: Tepuk kepala anak seolah-olah memakaikan topi.

readAloudNotes.en: Lower your arms slowly, saying 'down, down, down'.
readAloudNotes.id: Turunkan tangan pelan-pelan sambil berkata 'turun, turun, turun'.

readAloudNotes.en: Wave goodbye, then give a big pretend yawn.
readAloudNotes.id: Lambaikan tangan, lalu pura-pura menguap lebar.

sequenceCards.id: Kartu 1: matahari mengintip di balik bukit

objectives.en: Listens to a short story about the parts of a day and joins in with actions.
objectives.id: Mendengarkan cerita pendek tentang bagian-bagian hari dan ikut bergerak.

objectives.en: Begins to link morning, midday and night with what the sky looks like.
objectives.id: Mulai menghubungkan pagi, siang, dan malam dengan keadaan langit.

meaning.en: a cool place out of the sun
meaning.id: tempat sejuk yang tidak terkena matahari

prompt.en: What happened after the sun was high?
prompt.id: Apa yang terjadi setelah matahari tinggi?

en: the sun went down and the sky turned orange
id: matahari turun dan langit menjadi jingga

prompt.en: Why did Adik play in the shade?
prompt.id: Mengapa Adik bermain di tempat teduh?

en: to stay cool away from the hot sun
id: supaya tetap sejuk, jauh dari matahari yang panas

connection.en: Every day the sun seems to rise, cross the sky and set because the Earth turns.
connection.id: Setiap hari matahari tampak terbit, melintasi langit, lalu terbenam karena Bumi berputar.

connection.en: A hat and shade protect us from the hot midday sun.
connection.id: Topi dan tempat teduh melindungi kita dari panas matahari siang.

discussionPrompts.en: What do we do when the sun comes up?
discussionPrompts.id: Apa yang kita lakukan saat matahari terbit?

discussionPrompts.en: What colour was the sky when the sun went down?
discussionPrompts.id: Apa warna langit saat matahari terbenam?

offlineActivity.en: At the end of the day, stand by a window or outside with your child as the sky changes colour. Wave goodnight to the sun together. Never look straight at the sun.
offlineActivity.id: Di sore hari, berdirilah bersama anak di dekat jendela atau di luar saat warna langit berubah. Lambaikan tangan bersama untuk matahari. Jangan pernah menatap matahari langsung.

factChecks.claim: The sun appears to rise and set each day because the Earth turns.

safetyNotes.en: Never let your child look straight at the sun; it can hurt the eyes.
safetyNotes.id: Jangan biarkan anak menatap matahari langsung; itu bisa merusak mata.
